第十章只是斗不过你

来到派出所，出来的就是郑启，笑着对几人点点头。

“是来询问顾家人的情况吗？”

“对，有进展了吗？”

“刚才开会，领导说顾老太婆必须承认打人的事实，至于其他人可能关几天就得放回家。

毕竟昨天你们已经拿了赔偿，现在只追究孩子的事。”

还没说完，有辆车停在旁边，闫嫣偏头看下来的人，是位中年略显威严的男人。

“请问是闫嫣吗？”

闫嫣一副疑惑的模样，躲在妈妈身后，有事先找家长。

“我是闫嫣爸，你有事找她？”

中年男人露出微笑并伸出手，自我介绍。

“我是顾城的朋友，有事想找闫嫣谈谈，不知道能不能行个方便。”

“找我谈吧，我闺女身心俱疲，还是别打扰到她了。”

“行，咱们就车上谈吧。”

闫和平坐上汽车，一点也不担心顾城找来任何人，反正谁来都一样。

“我先自我介绍一下，我叫陈伯山，算是顾城的朋友吧。

前不久听说你女儿发生的事，很遗憾，我不为顾城讲情，只希望闫家能给他一个改过自新的机会。”

“哦？如何给他改过的机会。”

闫和平从不把人性和公平看的重，因为在权利面前这些都不存在。

“错已铸成，我让顾城同意离婚，并补偿给闫嫣五百块钱，分两年还完，你看如何？”

闫和平笑了，被气笑的。

“看来顾城身份很不一般呐，一个贫农出身的普通工人，却在亲眼看着媳妇被亲妈打流产后，还能有身份不普通的人前来说情。

难道他的身份已经大过于一条生命，难道这就是你处事的标准。五百块，还分两年还，你糟践谁呢。”

气运，打不死，就算遇到困难总会出现人救。

这不，人来了，表面带着歉意，说出的条件却是在羞辱人，想用钱来打发，可他闫家还真不缺钱。

Chapter 10 I just can’t beat you

When they arrived at the police station, Zheng Qi came out, smiling and nodding to a few people.

"Are you here to ask about the Gu family?"

"Yes, is there any progress?"

"In the meeting just now, the leader said that Mrs. Gu must admit to the fact that she beat someone, and the others may be detained for a few days and then released home.

After all, you already received the compensation yesterday, and now you are only pursuing the child."

Before she finished speaking, a car parked next to her. Yan Yan turned her head and saw that the person she saw was a middle-aged man with a slightly majestic look.

"Is this Yan Yan?"

Yan Yan looked confused and hid behind her mother, not asking her parents first.

"I'm Yan Yan's father. Do you have anything to ask her about?"

The middle-aged man smiled and extended his hand, introducing himself.

"I'm a friend of Gu Cheng. I want to talk to Yan Yan about something. I wonder if it can be convenient."

"Talk to me. My daughter is exhausted both physically and mentally. It's best not to disturb her."

"Okay, let's talk in the car."

Yan Heping got into the car and was not worried at all that Gu Cheng would find anyone. It would be the same no matter who came.

"Let me introduce myself first. My name is Chen Boshan, I guess I am a friend of Gu Cheng.

I heard about what happened to your daughter not long ago. I'm sorry that I won't intercede for Gu Cheng. I just hope that the Yan family can give him a chance to change his ways."

"Oh? How to give him a chance to change."

Yan Heping never attaches great importance to humanity and fairness, because these do not exist in the face of rights.

"The mistake has been made. I asked Gu Cheng to agree to the divorce and compensate Yan Yan with 500 yuan, which will be paid back in two years. What do you think?"

Yan Heping laughed angrily.

"It seems that Gu Cheng's identity is very unusual. An ordinary worker from a poor peasant background, but after witnessing his daughter-in-law being aborted by her own mother, someone with an extraordinary identity came to intercede.

Could it be that his identity is bigger than a life? Is this the standard by which you deal with things?Five hundred yuan, payable in two years, who are you ruining?"

Luck, if you can't be beaten to death, even if you encounter difficulties, someone will always appear to save you.

No, the man came, looking apologetic on the surface, but the conditions he stated were humiliating. He wanted to spend money to get rid of it, but the Yan family was really not short of money.
